## Presets, job behavior, and workflow controls

- Updated Streaming and Music Video encoding defaults, including scene-cut detection, B-frames, spatial AQ, speed, and H.264 max rates.
- Configuration and preset files refresh at startup when their remote freshness tags are newer. App defaults and required job behavior now come from `config.ini`, with intentional preset overrides in `presets.ini`.
- Music Video only invokes CCExtractor when the scan detects CEA captions and an eligible caption stream is selected for output.
- The Filters tab's required output behavior controls now affect stream mapping and metadata handling. Surround processing reflects whether the selected source has eligible surround audio.
- When retaining surround audio and adding a stereo downmix, the Audio tab now exposes the generated track's codec, bitrate, language, and output flags.
- Added **Start New** to the pre-encode workspace to clear the current source queue and preview cache and return to the welcome page.
- Reduced duplicated test defaults and aligned legacy custom preset coverage with config-driven fallback values.
